items.title: How Far Can NVIDIA Stock Fall In A Demand Scare?
items.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) stock trades near $212, about 10% below its 52-week high, and it has gone nowhere over the past three months. The company itself has not been standing still. So it is worth asking the uncomfortable question: how far does a stock like this fall when a real shock arrives, and how long would you wait to get it back.

items.title: This AI Stock Could Be Worth Far More Than Investors Think
items.summary: Broadcom just posted AI revenue growth of 221% year over year and guided for even bigger numbers ahead, yet the stock sits well off its highs and trades at a fraction of its closest custom-chip rival's multiple. Something in that math does not add up.

items.title: Credo Powers AI Networks With New 1.6T ZeroFlap Optics Launch

items.title: Wall Street Sees 56% Upside in Broadcom After Summer Selloff
items.summary: Broadcom posted record AI chip numbers and Wall Street still hammered the stock, leaving analysts pointing to a gap between price and target that rarely opens this wide on a mega-cap. Here is what the sell side is betting the market is missing.

items.title: 3 Semiconductor Stocks to Buy Before AI Demand Explodes in September
items.summary: Hyperscalers keep pulling forward orders for custom silicon, high-bandwidth memory, and networking chips, and three semiconductor names just raised guidance into the surge. One of them already sees a $230 billion revenue trajectory taking shape, and another reports before the month ends.
